name: False Hero
source:
There are 6 female characters in the game. Sebastian, the protagonist of the game, can change their lives tremendously. But you will decide how.

[From [url=https://enyo-1.itch.io/false-hero]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作共有6名女性角色登场。男主角塞巴斯蒂安足以彻底改变她们的人生——但究竟如何改变，全由你来决定。

[摘自[url=https://enyo-1.itch.io/false-hero]itch.io[/url]]
